_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen-host-adapters.cjs — do not edit; change the source and re-run. Source: the canonical Claude Code manifest (.claude-plugin/plugin.json -> mcpServers) — the one server list all hosts translate from. PRIORITY PROFILE for Cursor, not loaded by any host — the fallback list for the reported ~40-tool cap (M1A-VERIFY: neither the cap nor the counts below are measured; they show why the cut sits where it does). Two ways to apply it: (a) leave mcp.json alone and turn the dropped servers off in Cursor Settings -> MCP — nothing in the checkout changes; (b) copy this block over mcp.json in your clone, which is deliberate local drift that doctor.cjs and gen-host-adapters.cjs --check will both report, and `node scripts/gen-host-adapters.cjs` undoes. To change the cut for everyone, move CURSOR_KEEP_RANKS in the generator and re-run — note that if ~40 turns out to be a hard ceiling the running totals below say only ranks 1-2 fit. The cut sits at 4 because the plan's ranking keeps one browser server and figma usable; the measured cap behaviour (M1a) decides which of the two wins.
_priority: 1. atlassian (~31 tools, running total ~31) — KEPT: Jira is the spine of every workflow — ticket read, TA, steps to test, comments, transitions
2. shopify-dev-mcp (~5 tools, running total ~36) — KEPT: the whole Shopify docs + validator surface for five tools — the cheapest server on the list
3. chrome-devtools-mcp (~29 tools, running total ~65) — KEPT: in-browser validation; chosen over playwright for console/network/performance access
4. figma-dev-mode (~10 tools, running total ~75) — KEPT: design context for develop + QA; local Dev Mode server, no auth, small tool surface
5. playwright (~24 tools) — dropped: second browser stack, capability overlaps chrome-devtools; the plan picks one
6. notion-mcp (~29 tools) — dropped: doc-reader reaches a shared Notion page over the web when the server is absent
